recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this seed; future review of AllergyIntolerance clinicalStatus invariants should start with the later FHIR-25514 and FHIR-28458 decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-18831 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification Patient Care STU3 issue asking to remove the AllergyIntolerance.clinicalStatus requirement when verificationStatus is not entered-in-error because sending systems may not know the status. The final resolution kept the invariant but added a comment pointing to the extensibility Special-Case guidance when clinicalStatus is missing.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites GH#ef05a01a0bea. That commit is present in history and says GF#18831 added a comment to AllergyIntolerance.clinicalStatus; its spreadsheet hunk added the Special-Case missing-data sentence. The later StructureDefinition source refactor preserved that sentence, and a 2023 QA commit corrected the historical clincalStatus typo.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini. Later published issues FHIR-25514 and FHIR-28458 changed the invariant family: FHIR-25514 removed ait-1 and converted the requirement into should-present guidance with a negated-code exception, while FHIR-28458 removed AllergyIntolerance clinicalStatus invariants and added refuted-status guidance. Existing combined-branch audit commits already represent FHIR-25514, FHIR-23008, and FHIR-28458.
